name: @tycoslide/theme-default
description: Default reference theme for tycoslide — Inter font, purple/navy palette

scripts.plugin: tycoslide-generate-plugin && mkdir -p skills/tycoslide/references && cp ../../docs/SKILL.md skills/tycoslide/SKILL.md && cp ../../docs/{markdown-syntax,cli,troubleshooting,authoring-guide,components}.md skills/tycoslide/references/
scripts.validate: command -v claude >/dev/null && claude plugin validate . || echo 'Skipping plugin validation (claude CLI not found)'
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run plugin && npm run validate
scripts.zip: npm pack && mv *.tgz skills/tycoslide/ && zip -r $(node -p "require('./package.json').name.replace(/^@/,'').replace(/\\//,'-')+'-'+require('./package.json').version").zip .claude-plugin/ skills/ && rm skills/tycoslide/*.tgz
